$comment: Source sheets for party-game art. `npm run party-sprites` crops each sprite (rect = [x, y, width, height] in sheet pixels) and writes it to static/img/party/<out>, which is where core/Sprite.js loads from. Add a sheet here, then its sprites; see assets/party/README.md.

coup-roles.note: Role cards for Power Grab (Coup). 6 cards × 3 identical rows; only the first row is sliced. Cards measured from their black outlines (≈ 285 × 482 px).

clocktower-logos.note: Edition logos (Trouble Brewing, Bad Moon Rising, Sects & Violets) from wiki.bloodontheclocktower.com, © The Pandemonium Institute, used with permission. Shown on the role-pack picker.

clocktower-icons.note: Official Blood on the Clocktower character icons (art by Aidan Roberts, © The Pandemonium Institute), downloaded from wiki.bloodontheclocktower.com Icon_<name>.png and used with permission. One file per character key in games/clocktower/roles.js.
